summary: The construction and proof are correct for every integer m >= 4. The real-fiber calculation yields the stated full-dimensional convex symmetrization, and the integer support enumeration includes every nonempty fiber and excludes all zero-volume lattice fibers. Both cases of the original body's depth estimate cover all mixed points, including boundary points. Reflection gives the symmetrized origin depth at least half the total mass even for halfspaces with positive boundary mass, while continuous-coordinate cuts give the matching upper bound at every point. The exact mass ratio and its decay prove failure of every absolute positive maximum-depth comparison factor. No mathematical error or gap was found.
